command.mac: Probe c107. Measure, do not fix. 1) Run `claude --version` and record it. 2) Run `git branch probe-c107 HEAD` in this repo. 3) On this turn, which I typed, call start_session twice with kind user_asked: title "probe c107 A" and "probe c107 B", source branch probe-c107, prompt "Run git branch --show-current and reply with the branch, then stop." 4) Then call start_session once with kind offer, title "probe c107 C", same branch and prompt. 5) For each of A, B and C record: card shown yes/no (ask me in one line; I answer yes or no), started yes/no, branch the new session reports. 6) Clean up: archive sessions A, B and C, then run `git branch -D probe-c107`. 7) Send the result as one message: the version, then one line per start (kind, card, started, branch kept yes/no). Send it with send_message to session_013NEJL2hB1pLZPDpzas7VgB if that tool exists here; else print it so I can paste it to the coordinator.

context:
Goal: your local coordinators start their lanes without a press from you (your ask, 13:24 CST).
Problem (goal): the card is the desktop app's own and shows even in Bypass mode, so no setting of ours removes it. One possible fix: starts on a turn you typed may show no card. Only a Mac session can test that, and the cloud cannot reach your Mac right now.
The probe starts three throwaway sessions, records whether each showed a card and kept its branch, then archives them and deletes its test branch.
The result goes to the coordinator, which then brings you the pick.
